3. The plaintiff's case, put in a nutshell, is that the suit land measuring an area 1.52 acres, appertaining to plot Nos. 3541, 3554 and 1770 of RS Khatian No. 95 and SA Khatian No. 198 of Mouza Solak, the area of CS Khatian No. 1027 having 7.84 acres of land, originally belonged to Edel Sharif who died leaving behind two sons namely, Abdul Aziz and Abdul Kader, two daughters namely, Sonabaru @ Shams-unless and Pakhi Bibi @ Fakirunnessa; that they having been interested in the suit property as heirs of Edel Sharif made a transfer there-of to one Abdul Jabbar by a registered kabala dated 31st Chaitra, 1340 BS corresponding to 14-6-1933 AD; that Abdul Jabbar possessed the suit land and after his death his heirs i.e. the plaintiffs, have been possessing the same; that RS. and SA record of the suit land had been wrongly prepared in the names of the defendants; that in the first part of Aswin, 1381 BS they came to know about the erroneous record of rights of the suit land; that they came to know that the deceased defendant No. 1 Syed Abdus Sattar purchased the suit land including other lands in auction; subsequently, defendant Nos. 2 and 3 (herein opposite party Nos. 9 and 10) purchased the suit land from Syed Abdus Sattar and by dint of that purchase, the defendant Nos. 2 and 3 have got no possession over the suit land; that the plaintiffs are in possession in the suit land on cultivation and by transferring some portion thereof to South Solak Free Primary School by a registered kabala. Hence, the suit. 

 16. Admittedly, the suit land originally be-longed to Edel Sharif. The plaintiffs, on the basis of a registered kabala deed dated 14-6-1933 (Exhibit 1), claim right, title over the suit land. Exhibit 1 is the certified copy of the aforesaid registered kabala. Exhibits 2-2(b) are CS, RS and SA khatians purported to have been proved that the suit land was recorded in the CS, khatian in the name of Edel Sharif. RS and SA khatians prove that the record of the suit land had been made in the name of Syed Abdus Sattar, predecessor of defendants. Exhibit 3 is plot Index of the suit property appertaining to some plots as mentioned in the Schedule of the plaint.
